# Schemas and downloads

Every file here is part of the **OLIP 0.1 draft** or the **OLIP 0.2 additions**. URLs under `/spec/0.1/` and `/spec/0.2/` stay stable for each line; a new minor line gets a new folder (see [Versioning](/spec/versioning/)). Each schema's `$id` is its URL on this site.

:::note Licensing
Granted 2026-11-07: CC BY 4.0 with the OWFa 1.0 patent commitment for spec text and schemas, Apache 2.0 for code, CC0 1.0 for fictional examples. See [Licensing](/license/).
:::
